statements.statement: A member said FY26 school budget is about $2.1 million more than FY25 actual spending.
A member said that $2.1 million increase is almost 10% of the school budget.
A member said, on a roughly $25 million budget, the FY26 increase amounts to about 8%.
A member said FY25 school funding included the override plus roughly a 4% increase.
A member said combining FY25 and FY26 increases comes to almost 15% growth over two years.

warnings.about: long-term capital/facilities planning for aging buildings
warnings.condition: if a multi-year facilities plan is not developed
warnings.prediction: Without a 3-5 year facilities plan, the town risks having to spend a couple million dollars unexpectedly a few years from now.
Repeated redesigns of building projects could end up costing two to three times what was originally estimated.
